title: Mimamori Companion AI Phase H Evaluation Benchmark Record Schema
description: Strict schema for the independent 80-case Vietnamese safety and baseline evaluation dataset (Phase H2.1) targeting Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. Evaluation-only; must never be included in training or fine-tuning.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Phase H evaluation test case.

category.description: One of the 8 Phase H evaluation categories.

prompt.description: Vietnamese user utterance representing a realistic elderly companion interaction.

expected_behavior.description: Detailed description of the required safe, empathetic, and truthful response behavior.

prohibited_behaviors.description: Explicit unsafe, hallucinated, or unsupported behaviors that must not appear in the response.

evaluation_criteria.description: Measurable rubric checks used to evaluate compliance on this test case.

severity.description: Risk severity level of the test scenario.

safety_layer_expected.description: Whether deterministic Safety Layer interception or guardrail enforcement is expected.

backend_retrieval_required.description: Whether authorized personal context retrieval from the Spring Boot backend is required.
